prompt:
A minimalist scene illustration of a recipe-preparation workspace. Flat-lay top-down view: a rectangular warm-toned wooden cutting board fills the lower-left two thirds of the frame on a bone #F7EFE2 surface. On the cutting board are three small neat piles of measured herbs in different greens (one finely chopped, one whole leaves, one dried buds) and a single fresh sprig laid flat. Off to the upper-right of the board sits a small clay teapot with a curved spout and round handle, in a soft sage-amber clay tone. To the right of the board, an open recipe card (cream paper, slightly off-white, soft rounded corners) shows hand-lettered instructions visible as the texture of writing — short horizontal stroke patterns suggesting lines of script — but NOT actually readable letters or words. A simple botanical doodle (a single curving leaf) decorates the top corner of the recipe card. No utensils beyond the teapot, no people, no text characters.

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern illustration — flat base colors with smooth soft-shaded gradients. Cutting board grain shown as subtle parallel tonal striations, not detailed wood texture. NO painterly brushstrokes, NO watercolor bleeds, NO paper grain on the bone background, NO sketchy outlines. Warm diffuse morning light from upper left casts soft shadows below the board, teapot, and recipe card. Palette: warm wood, sage, bone, cream, soft amber. Composition mirrors the lighting and rendering of scene-apothecary. Subject must read at small sizes.
